make.name: Peugeot
make.description: French car maker whose family business dates to 1810 and which has built cars since the 1890s; part of PSA and, since 2021, Stellantis. After the Mitsubishi-built iOn (2010-2020) it moved to electric versions of most of its range: e-208, e-2008, e-308, e-408, e-3008, e-5008, e-Rifter and e-Traveller. Peugeot does not sell cars in the US.

logo.license: Trademark of Peugeot (Stellantis); official logo file from peugeot.co.uk

models.name: iOn
models.description: Four-seat electric city car rebadged from the Mitsubishi i-MiEV and built by Mitsubishi for PSA; sold in Europe from late 2010 until 2020. Its twin was the Citroën C-Zero.

generations.name: iOn
generations.description: Mitsubishi i-MiEV based; the PSA cars switched to an 80-cell 14.5 kWh pack from model year 2013.

models.name: e-208
models.description: Electric version of the second-generation 208 supermini, revealed at Geneva in March 2019 and built in Zaragoza and Trnava on the eCMP platform. It started with a 50 kWh / 100 kW powertrain, gained a 51 kWh / 115 kW version in late 2022, was facelifted in 2023 and got a 206 kW E-208 GTi in 2026.

generations.name: Second generation 208
generations.description: Original e-208 (deliveries from late 2019); WLTP range rose from 340 km to 362 km with a 2021 efficiency update.

generations.name: Facelift
generations.description: September 2023 facelift with the three-claw lights and new logo. From 2025 the 156 hp version is sold as "54 kWh" (same pack, gross figure); the 206 kW E-208 GTi went on sale in June 2026.

models.name: e-2008
models.description: Electric version of the second-generation 2008 small SUV, built in Vigo on the eCMP platform since 2019 (deliveries 2020). The 2023 facelift added a 54 kWh / 115 kW version; the 50 kWh version was dropped in 2025.

generations.name: Second generation 2008
generations.description: 50 kWh / 100 kW powertrain; range improved to about 346 km WLTP with the 2022 update.

generations.name: Facelift
generations.description: Mid-2023 facelift; the new 54 kWh / 115 kW powertrain raised WLTP range to 406 km.

models.name: e-308
models.description: Electric version of the third-generation 308, sold as a hatchback and SW estate since 2023 (built in Mulhouse on EMP2 V3). The 2025 facelift brought a 58 kWh battery and about 450 km WLTP.

generations.name: Third generation 308
generations.description: 54 kWh (51 kWh usable) NMC battery and 115 kW motor.

generations.name: Facelift
generations.description: Late-2025 facelift with new front; battery grew to 58.3 kWh (55.4 kWh usable).

models.name: E-408
models.description: Electric version of the 408 fastback crossover, on sale from late 2024 with a 58 kWh battery and 157 kW motor. The 408 range was facelifted in January 2026.

generations.name: Original
generations.description: EMP2-based fastback crossover; 58.2 kWh battery, WLTP up to 456 km.

generations.name: Facelift
generations.description: Facelift unveiled 9 January 2026 with a new grille, three-claw lights and illuminated logos; same 58 kWh powertrain.

models.name: E-3008
models.description: Electric version of the third-generation 3008, a fastback SUV revealed on 12 September 2023 and the first car on Stellantis' STLA Medium platform, built in Sochaux. Offered with 73 kWh (FWD and dual-motor AWD) and 97 kWh batteries.

generations.name: Third generation 3008
generations.description: STLA Medium; deliveries from 2024, dual-motor AWD orderable from July 2025.

models.name: E-5008
models.description: Electric version of the third-generation 5008, the seven-seat long-wheelbase sister of the e-3008, introduced on 20 March 2024 and built in Sochaux on STLA Medium.

generations.name: Third generation 5008
generations.description: STLA Medium, seven seats; dual-motor AWD from July 2025.

models.name: e-Rifter
models.description: Electric version of the Rifter leisure MPV (Standard/M five-seat and Long/XL seven-seat), sold from mid-2021; facelifted in 2024 with a new 50 kWh pack. Twin of the Citroën ë-Berlingo and Opel Combo Electric.

generations.name: Original
generations.description: 50 kWh / 100 kW powertrain shared with the ë-Berlingo.

generations.name: Facelift
generations.description: March 2024 facelift with new front and a revised 50 kWh battery (about 340 km WLTP).

models.name: Partner Tepee Electric
models.description: Small-battery electric version of the second-generation Partner Tepee leisure MPV, sold in small numbers from 2017 to early 2020; replaced by the e-Rifter.

generations.name: Second generation Partner
generations.description: Conversion of the second-generation Partner Tepee.

models.name: e-Traveller
models.description: Electric version of the Traveller people carrier (Expert-based, up to nine seats) sold from late 2020 with 50 kWh or 75 kWh batteries and a 100 kW motor; facelifted in 2024. Twin of the Citroën ë-SpaceTourer and Opel Zafira Electric.

generations.name: Facelift
generations.description: April 2024 facelift with the new Peugeot face and more range from the 75 kWh pack.
